title: sort on ListView renders blank repeater in Edit View Config — z.union hides items from SchemaForm 🐛
body:
## Problem

In Edit View Config → Columns & Filters → Sort, clicking "Add sort" produces an empty row with no field picker or order dropdown. Users cannot configure default sort at all.

## Cause

`ListViewSchema.sort` is defined as a union wrapping both a legacy string form and the canonical array form. The array definition ends up inside an `anyOf` branch, but the ObjectUI SchemaForm repeater only reads `schema.items` at the top level — it finds `undefined` and renders zero sub-fields.

## Suggested fix

Drop the legacy string variant and use the canonical `z.array(z.object({ field, order }))` directly. The string form was already deprecated in #3373 and its removal was deferred to a separate cycle.

## Related

- #3373 kept the union intact intentionally
- Companion fix possible in objectui (repeater scanning `anyOf` as fallback) but the spec fix is the true root cause
